Un negocio pequeño no suele tener un pro: A small business does not usually have a work problem: it has a status problem. Every open project lives scattered between somebody's head, a folder of emails, a spreadsheet nobody updates and a messaging group. Nobody can answer the simple question quickly: what is next on each front?
El coste no se ve en ninguna factura. Se: The cost never shows up on an invoice. It is paid in deadlines discovered late, in calls to reconstruct what was already discussed, and in decisions postponed because putting the information in order costs more than taking them.
Un gemelo digital: un modelo del dato do: A digital twin: a data model where every fact lives exactly once, and an AI that operates it daily. For organisation, three concrete pieces:
<b>Proyectos con siguiente paso.</b> Cad: Projects with a next step. Each project is a record with its timeline of milestones, its current phase and a single line answering what matters: what the next move is and who it depends on. It works just as well for a building job, an inheritance, a language or a degree: anything with phases and deadlines.
<b>Tareas y calendario, sin duplicar.</b: Tasks and calendar, with no duplication. Tasks hold the what; the calendar holds the when: appointments and hard deadlines. Each thing lives in one place only and the two views stay in sync, so no list goes stale.
<b>Red de contactos con contexto.</b> Ca: Contacts with context. Every person who appears in a project has their record: what happened last with them and what comes next. Before a call, the context is ready in seconds.
Sobre ese modelo se pregunta en lenguaje: You ask questions of that model in plain language, and the answer comes back ordered and with its sources: which record each piece of data comes from.
Cómo funciona a diario: How it works day to day
La demo lo cuenta con un negocio escenif: The demo tells it through a staged business (sample data, not real): three open projects. A shop refurbishment on site, with its timeline of milestones and the next step in plain view: the surveyor's visit. An opening licence in progress, with a request for further information to answer. And a new website at proposal stage, waiting on a choice of quote.
A un lado, las tareas: enviar la documen: On one side, the tasks: send the documents to the bank, get quotes for signage, renew the insurance. On the other, the calendar: the surveyor's visit on Tuesday, the accountant on Thursday, and the deadline for the request on Friday. Nothing is in two places at once, so ticking a task off is enough for the whole system to know.
La red de contactos guarda el hilo de ca: The contact network keeps the thread of each relationship: the architect on the refurbishment, with the drawings already received and the finishes still to confirm; the web studio, with the proposal sent and an answer expected on Thursday; the accountant, with the response under way (people and dates staged).
Y la escena final es la que importa: pre: And the closing scene is the one that matters: asking “what is on this week?” and getting the answer back ordered, with Friday's deadline in the foreground and every statement linked to its record. That is what AI does when the data is properly modelled: it does not search, it consults.
El primer gemelo digital lo construí par: I built the first digital twin for myself, and I keep it up to date daily with AI since June 2026. Today, in the organisation area:
Proyectos con su siguiente paso siempre: Projects with their next step always in view; tasks and calendar in sync; contacts up to date.
Más de 400 entradas de bitácora y más de: More than 400 log entries and more than 300 documents searchable in plain language.
Una auditoría automática comprueba a dia: An automatic audit checks every day that nothing is lost.
